{"source":"import Base

# Missing rows and missing columns share the same dead-cell boundary.
def Life.head(cells: List<&2, U32>) -> U32:
  Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, cells), 0)

def Life.column(above: List<&2, U32>, middle: List<&2, U32>, below: List<&2, U32>) -> U32:
  (Life.head(above) + Life.head(middle) + Life.head(below) : U32)

# Including the center turns B3/S23 into total=3 or (total=4 and alive).
def Life.rule(alive: U32, +total: U32) -> U32:
  Bool.to_u32(Bool.or(U32.is_eq(total, 3),
    Bool.and(U32.is_eq(total, 4), U32.is_eq(alive, 1))))

# Carry the previous column sum; the remaining lists expose this column and next.
def Life.row(
  middle: List<&2, U32>, +above: List<&2, U32>,
  +below: List<&2, U32>, left: U32
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match middle:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{+alive, +rest}:
      +upper = List.tail(&2, U32, above)
      +lower = List.tail(&2, U32, below)
      +center = (Life.head(above) + alive + Life.head(below) : U32)
      right = Life.column(upper, rest, lower)
      Life.rule(alive, (left + center + right : U32))
        <> Life.row(rest, upper, lower, center)

def Life.rows(
  rows: List<&2, List<&2, U32>>, above: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rows:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{+middle, +rest}:
      below = Maybe.default(&2, List<&2, U32>,
        List.head(&2, List<&2, U32>, rest), Nil{})
      List.append(&2, U32, Life.row(middle, above, below, 0),
        Life.rows(rest, middle))

def Life.split(
  height: Nat, +width: Nat, +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, List<&2, U32>>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      List.take(&2, U32, cells, width)
        <> Life.split(rest, width, List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width))

def step(width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  Life.rows(Life.split(U32.to_nat(height), U32.to_nat(width), cells), Nil{})

def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+rest:
      evolve(rest, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
","hypothesis":"The stimulus suggests a center surrounded by symmetric, overlapping neighborhoods. Represent the board as immutable rows and slide three column sums across each row. Their sum includes the center, making B3/S23 exactly total=3 or (total=4 and alive). Empty lists supply dead boundaries on every side. Structural recursion preserves row-major order, separates old and new generations, and bounds every traversal; evolution recurses on turns. Compiler and runtime verification remain pending.","findings":"none"}
